messages.subject: GEOM_BAR
parts:
Hello,

In the GEOM_BAR opts (), the script.text.x=theme_text(angle=90,
hjust=1, size=16, face="bold") does not seem to produce the "Facet-
Text" large enough.

May I send you the data set so that you can reproduce the example?

I would appreciate receiving your help.

Thank you in advance,

Pradip Muhuri

###### The R Script is as follows:


#setwd ("F:/Disorders")
setwd ("E:/")

#setwd ("C:/Documents and Settings/pradip.muhuri/My Documents")

library (ggplot2)

myplot <- function(lFrame,yTrigger )
{
lFrame$yvar = rep(c(0),28)
lFrame$yvar_l = rep(c(0),28)
lFrame$yvar_u = rep(c(0),28)
title =" "
outFile = "default.png"

{

lFrame <- subset(lFrame, agerace>0)
numrow <- 2

lFrame$yvar_l = lFrame$sumyr_l
lFrame$yvar_u = lFrame$sumyr_u

lFrame$agerace <- factor(lFrame$agerace,levels=c
(5,2,4,7,1,6,3,12,9,11,14,8,13,10),
labels=c("Asian 12-17", "Black 12-17", "HI/OPI
12-17",
"Hisp 12-17", "White 12-17","Multi R
12-17",
"AI/AN 12-17",
"Asian 18+", "Black 18+", "HI/OPI 18+",
"Hisp 18+", "White 18+","Multi R 18+",
"AI/AN 18+"))
title ="Past-Year Illicit Drug Use By Gender (2002-2010)"
outFile = "sumyr_sex.png"
}

{

numrow <- 2
lFrame$agerace <- factor(lFrame$agerace,levels=c
(5,2,4,7,1,6,3,12,9,11,14,8,13,10),
labels=c("Asian 12-17", "Black 12-17", "HI/OPI
12-17",

12-17",

"Asian 18+", "Black 18+", "HI/OPI 18+",
"Hisp 18+", "White 18+","Multi R 18+",
"AI/AN 18+"))

lFrame$yvar_u = lFrame$abodill_u

# In the data frame, race/ethnicity is coded as follows:

limits <- aes(ymax = yvar_u, ymin=yvar_l)
dodge <- position_dodge(width=1)

geom_bar(position=dodge) +
geom_errorbar(limits, position=dodge, width=0.25) +
#geom_text (aes(label = abodill,colour="black", face="bold")) +
facet_wrap(~ agerace, nrow=numrow)+
#ylim()+

xlab("")+
ylab("Percentage")+


opts(legend.position="none",
title=title,
axis.title.y = theme_text(face = 'bold', size = 16, angle =
90),
axis.text.y=theme_text(size=16, hjust=1, face="bold"),
axis.text.x=theme_text(angle=90, hjust=1, size=16,
face="bold"),
script.text.x=theme_text(angle=90, hjust=1, size=16,
face="bold"),
#script.text.y=theme_text(angle=90, hjust=1, size=16,
face="bold"),
#panel.background=theme_rect(),
plot.title = theme_text(size=24, face="bold")
)

print (p)

Did you mean script.text.x or strip.text.x? The latter is implemented
in ggplot2; the former, AFAIK, is not.

HTH,
Dennis
